text: ぼうそうぞくも　でて　いったし　マヨちゃんも　ぶじ　だったし　ほんと　よかったわー

structure.jp: ぼうそうぞくも　でて　いったし
マヨちゃんも　ぶじ　だったし
ほんと　よかったわー

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a sentence lists it as one of several reasons: 'for one thing... and also'. でて　いったし = 'they've left, for one thing'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form says the action moves away from where the speaker is. でて　いった = 'went out and away'.
